title: Injectivity criterion using small-valued etale sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] in universe u and T an abelian sheaf with coefficients in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}. Assume that for every monomorphism f : A → B with each B(U) u-small, every g : A → T extends to B. Then T is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions].

source.place: Injectives, Lemma 19.7.3: extension criterion across subsheaves of free representables.

proof.text: Use the concrete affine-model free-Yoneda coproduct G_X. It separates large-valued sheaf morphisms by the proved separator lemma, and each of its section groups is u-small by the section-size bound.

For every subobject M of G_X and every map M to T, apply hT to the monomorphism M.arrow into G_X using its section-size bound. This produces a lift for every square from M.arrow to T to 0; its right face commutes because 0 is a zero object. The large-valued sheaf category is Grothendieck abelian by the proved upstream instance CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.isGrothendieckAbelian_sheaf_smallEtaleTopology at universe u+1. Mathlib IsGrothendieckAbelian.generatingMonomorphisms_rlp identifies right lifting against these subobject inclusions with right lifting against all monomorphisms. Finally injective_iff_rlp_monomorphisms_zero gives Injective T.

proof_origin.place: Single concrete small-valued generator; categorical extension argument replaced by Mathlib generatingMonomorphisms_rlp and injective_iff_rlp_monomorphisms_zero.

mathlib_searches.query: Injective objects in abelian sheaves criterion extension from small sheaves
Universe lift of an injective abelian sheaf on a small site is injective
mathlib_searches.results: No direct sheaf result; ModuleCat.ulift_injective_of_injective concerns individual modules.
No sheaf injectivity criterion. Generic Injective.factors, ULift full faithfulness, essential-image lifting, and reflection of limits supply the descent proof.

from.place: Small test objects in step 1 and the injectivity criterion in step 2.

lean.statement: theorem etale_injective_of_small_extensions (X : Scheme.{u}) (T : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hT : ∀ {A B : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}, (∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, Small.{u} (B.obj.obj U)) → ∀ (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f] (g : A ⟶ T), ∃ h : B ⟶ T, f ≫ h = g) : Injective T
